 Key facts: Coinbase Reports $3.4B Loans; 25% Fees; Blocks $4.7M Scam
 Less than 1 min read COIN Coinbase Borrow, powered by Morpho on Base, has originated over $3.4 billion in loans since January 2025. As of Nov. 17, $1.63 billion in USDC loans were backed by $2.86 billion in collateral. 
 2 sources 
 Coinbase said prediction markets and derivatives generated 25% of trading fee revenue in Q3. Prediction markets reached a reported $200 million annualized revenue run rate. 
 Crypto Briefing 
 Coinbase (COIN) said its AI scam defenses blocked about $4.7 million in attempted transfers to a fake crypto giveaway promoted by an Elon Musk deepfake. The system stopped 91% of attempts. 
 The Block 
 Coinbase Global, Inc. Class A (COIN) launched tokenized U.S. stocks earlier this year.
